old_caption: The video captures a breathtaking fireworks display over a serene body of water at night. The sky is dark, providing a stark contrast to the vibrant colors of the fireworks. The fireworks burst in various shapes and sizes, predominantly in shades of purple, blue, and white, creating a mesmerizing spectacle. Each burst is followed by a reflection on the calm surface of the water below, doubling the visual impact of the display. In the background, faint lights from buildings and structures suggest an urban setting, adding depth to the scene. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, allowing viewers to fully absorb the beauty and scale of the fireworks show. The overall atmosphere is one of celebration and tranquility, with the fireworks serving as the focal point against the quiet backdrop of the night sky and the still water.

caption: The video captures a night fireworks display over a calm dark body of water, with a distant shoreline of scattered city lights, a single slender tower on the horizon, and faint angled searchlight beams steady on the left. Two dotted light clusters, a looped shape on the left and a broader shape on the right, hang in the upper sky in purple and green points, each mirrored below. Small orange points emerge along the lower edges of these clusters and multiply into a horizontal row of radial starbursts as the dotted outlines thin into faint purple arcs overhead. The starbursts consolidate into a row of purple circular wheel patterns, and the water reflection turns predominantly purple. Above this row, gold-orange spherical bursts ignite near the left and right and grow, expanding into large chrysanthemum-like spheres while the purple wheels persist beneath. The lower-half patterns remain mirror reflections of the sky, shifting color in step with each new bloom.
